mapper.sql: c.space_id, c.id AS chunk_id, c.document_id, c.chunk_index, c.page_number, c.char_start, c.char_end, c.image_ref, c.image_label, c.content AS excerpt, d.name AS document_name, d.parse_version

FROM document_content c INNER JOIN document d ON d.id = c.document_id INNER JOIN space s ON s.id = d.space_id WHERE c.space_id = d.space_id AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.parse_status = 'READY' AND s.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
AND MATCH(c.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY MATCH(c.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) DESC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
